subject: math
cluster: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties

items.prompt:
A square is a special kind of
A) rectangle
B) triangle
C) circle
D) pentagon

steps: A square has all rectangle attributes.

items.prompt:
Is every rectangle a square?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only big ones
D) Only tilted ones

All rectangles are
A) parallelograms
B) triangles
C) circles
D) pentagons

Why is a square a rhombus?
A) It has four equal sides
B) It has three sides
C) It is round
D) It has no sides
items.answer: A) It has four equal sides

items.prompt:
A property true of all rectangles is also true of squares because
A) a square is a kind of rectangle
B) they are unrelated
C) a rectangle is a square
D) squares have no attributes
items.answer: A) a square is a kind of rectangle

items.prompt:
Is every parallelogram a rectangle?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Always
D) Only squares

Squares, rectangles, and rhombuses are all
A) parallelograms
B) triangles
C) circles
D) pentagons

steps: All have two pairs of parallel sides.

items.prompt:
Is every rhombus a square?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Always
D) Only big ones

steps: Rhombuses need not have right angles.
